mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is always associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of its absolute value. This is because low interest rates consistently compress discount rates and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, the next 20 trading days produce negative returns (or non-positive) in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 5.0%, the next 20 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and employment (PAYEMS) signals a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline, the next 20 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized), central banks are forced to tighten policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%, the next 20 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is below 1000, the next 20 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100, the next 20 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers immediate risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is above 5.0%, the next 5 trading days produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 for the mean return being negative.
